excerpt.en: Three rackets that make learning faster — tested by real beginners.
excerpt.zh: 三支让上手更快的球拍——真实新手实测。

affiliateNote.zh: 购买链接为联盟推广链接。

body.en:
1) Head Gravity MP — oversized sweet spot, very forgiving on off-center hits. Best all-round first racket. 2) Wilson Clash 100L — light and arm-friendly, ideal if you had tennis elbow or slow swing speed. 3) Babolat Pure Drive Junior 26 — don't laugh: for smaller adults or true beginners, a 26-inch junior frame builds technique faster than a full-size one.

What matters more than the racket: string tension. Ask your shop to string at 50-55 lbs for comfort. Purchase links below are affiliate links.
body.zh:
1) Head Gravity MP——甜区超大，打偏了也宽容，全能首拍之选。2) Wilson Clash 100L——轻、护手臂，有网球肘或挥速慢的理想选择。3) Babolat Pure Drive Junior 26——别笑：对身材较小或纯新手，26 寸青少年拍反而能让技术动作建立得更快。

比球拍更重要的是穿线磅数：让店家用 50-55 磅，击球更舒适。

title.zh: 红土鞋全底纹选购指南

excerpt.en: Why full herringbone matters and which pairs last longest.
excerpt.zh: 为什么全人字纹很重要，以及哪些鞋最耐穿。

affiliateNote.zh: 购买链接为联盟推广链接。

body.en: Clay-specific outsoles use a full herringbone pattern that sheds red dust instead of packing it — on hard courts this pattern also slides slightly, which protects your knees. Top picks: Asics Gel-Resolution Clay (best durability), Nike Court Air Zoom Clay (best cushioning), adidas Barricade Clay (best value last season's colorway). Buy half a size up: feet swell on hot courts. Links below are affiliate links.
body.zh:
红土专用外底采用全人字纹，能把红土粉末排出去而不是积在鞋底；在硬地上这种底纹还能提供轻微滑动，保护膝盖。推荐：Asics Gel-Resolution Clay（最耐穿）、Nike Court Air Zoom Clay（缓震最好）、adidas Barricade Clay（上赛季配色性价比最高）。买大半码：天热脚会膨胀。
